value.rationale: The Weyl constant is a natural effective spectral-rank invariant controlling approximation/singular-value counting and critical weak-Schatten mass, especially nontrivial because coordinate degree is anisotropic in several variables. The formula explicitly distinguishes angular multiplicities and gives exact rational 31/640 in the two-dimensional quartic case; these are not specified by older yes/no Schatten classifications. No downstream application is needed to make this natural invariant meaningful.
